scientific.integrity: The displayed paper angle is solved exactly on a persistent sign-alternating one-coordinate gradient. Closed trigonometric formulas yield reciprocal-amplitude symmetry, sharp extrema, and exact variant crossovers.
limitations: One-coordinate input-response theorem for the paper-form angular coefficient.
Does not characterize the full Adam-style parameter trajectory.
The official implementation includes extra state-selection logic beyond the displayed adjacent-angle minimum.
No claim about whether the scale dependence improves or harms a specific training task.

title: AngularGrad's paper angle has an exact reciprocal-amplitude phase diagram
